We’re back to pouring sweat and tears into making these games a reality as soon as we can.[/p][p]– Martin[/p][p]The Blue Brain Games Team[/p]

notes.title: The House of Da Vinci is going VR!
notes.notes:
Good morning people!

Today is a good day for an announcement. The announcement I am going to make is very exciting for us and I hope it will also be very exciting at least for some of you.
We have been secretly working on an amazing adventure from the world of The House of Da Vinci and it will come out later this year for virtual reality headsets. Some of you asked for this, and some of you didn’t, but it is coming either way. What am I even talking about?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31280850/1e6f3b23a7ac629a1781e9fdfad1c5fd6844aacf.png[/img]

Are you hungry for more information? The Steam page is live and you can head there to learn more about the game and Wishlist it to be among the first to play it as soon as it comes out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948310

Not sure, why are you continuing to read this instead of going to The House of Da Vinci VR Steam page, but let me reiterate: Yes, we are making a virtual reality game. Yes, it’s gonna be amazing. Yes, all the puzzles and environments were completely redone to use the potential of VR. Yes, you can Wishlist it right now and play it in several months!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31280850/8b46d3955704fce6e5c32b5b06c6dd7044cc910a.png[/img]

notes.title: Trading cards for The House of Da Vinci are here!
notes.notes:
Leonardo da Vinci never planned to release most of his work. In his diaries, his drawings and watercolor paintings are beautiful and detailed but primarily functional, done only in shades of brown and black depending on the materials used.
In the works he actually intended for the eyes of the public, (like the city plan of Imola or the map of Valdichiana – seriously, if you haven’t seen those, look them up) we can enjoy vibrant colors only adding to both the depth and the beauty.
And this is the idea behind our trading cards: what if some of his more famous inventions and tools got this special treatment? We can only imagine if it would look like our artwork, but we invite you to do the same.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31280850/5737c372d9b06015a1ef96a8f4f09c8654ef74e8.png[/img]

P.S. Now it’s official: you can also expect Steam trading cards for the second installment of our game in the coming days.

notes.title: The House of Da Vinci 3 is coming to Steam this fall
notes.notes:
We have some good news for those of you patiently waiting for the next installment of The House of Da Vinci. The development is well on its way, and we expect that it will be available on Steam store in the Fall of 2022. Read the details, check out the screenshots and add the game to your Wishlist so you do not miss the release!

👉 Add the game to your wishlist now: bit.ly/HDV-3


The grand finale to The House of Da Vinci trilogy is coming! Expect a great many new puzzles, a thrilling story, and the same (or even better) high quality that everybody came to love in our previous games.

[h2]THE STORY[/h2]

The time has finally come: become Giacomo one last time and join Leonardo da Vinci, the master of both art and science, as his friend and apprentice. Explore more of the Renaissance world full of puzzles, discover secret messages, and reveal mechanical wonders. Unravel conspiracies involving the most powerful people in Italy – and travel not only through space but time as well. Meet friends and rivals both old and new. Become the focus of a plan that might change history forever.

With sharp wits and an open mind, you will prevail.

[h2]KEY FEATURES[/h2]

[b]NEW ADVENTURE, NEW PUZZLES[/b]
Enjoy original new puzzles, and examine concealed objects and mechanisms to find out what makes them tick.

[b]USE THE PAST TO YOUR ADVANTAGE[/b]
Use the mysterious Oculus Perpetua to change the past, influencing your surroundings in the present and allowing you to solve the otherwise unsolvable.

[b]NEW AND IMPROVED INTERACTIONS[/b]
Find new ways to interact with the beautiful, handcrafted world around you. Control Giacomo's actions even more intuitively than ever before.

[b]VARIED LOCATIONS[/b]
Explore breathtaking new locations in Italy and beyond. Search them for clues and travel both in time and space.

[b]EPIC FINALE[/b]
Listen to fully voiced historical figures, watch epic cut scenes, and discover how the story of Giacomo concludes its final stage.

notes.title: The House of Da Vinci 2 is coming on May 29
notes.notes:
It's still home office season in our indie studio (safety first!), so we couldn't be as productive as before, BUT we have a nice surprise for all PC players out there: this is the official release date for The House of Da Vinci 2 on Steam!

👉 Add the game to your wishlist now: bit.ly/HDV2-Steam
🍏 Mac release will come soon after, we still have to do some more beta testing.

[b]The Story[/b]

Become Giacomo, the apprentice to the Renaissance genius, Leonardo da Vinci. Explore the world full of puzzles, mechanical gadgets and mind-twisting inventions. Travel through time and witness a series of mysterious events that led to the greatest discovery in human history.

Your most powerful weapon is your mind, wit and skill.

[b]Features[/b]

ORIGINAL MECHANICAL PUZZLES
Get your hands on hundreds of new objects, 3D puzzles and mechanical brain-twisters waiting to be unraveled.

TIME TRAVEL
Go back in time not only to reveal past mysteries and hidden objects – use unique Oculus Perpetua to shape the present in a significant way.

NEW TOUCH CONTROLS
Navigate through mesmerizing locations even more intuitively. All game controls have been redesigned and optimized to feel as intuitive as it gets.

VOICE NARRATED STORY
A pleasure for all senses: the whole story is now fully narrated. The goose bumps are inevitable.

MYSTERIOUS CUT SCENES
Including the one showing Leonardo da Vinci's creation of the famous The Last Supper.
